name: Flood Tunnel Clearance
description: The job in the drains: read the water, power the line, clear the feed. The two jobs run alongside each other.

checks.name: Read the water before touching anything

outcomes.criticalSuccess: A nest under the grate, several of them, still asleep. Starting the machinery will wake them, so they can get into position first.
outcomes.success: Something large lives under that water, more than one of it, and it's asleep.
outcomes.failure: Black water. Nothing they can read.

checks.name: Get power back to the drainage line

outcomes.criticalSuccess: Clean, first try. The others notice.
outcomes.failure: It comes up with a bang that carries through the drains. The nest wakes now, before anyone's in position.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, with a shower of sparks: whoever was working it is off-guard in the first round.

checks.name: Clear the jam in the compactor feed

outcomes.criticalSuccess: Clean and fast. The machinery starts smoothly.
outcomes.failure: It clears with a shove, and the compactor lurches into motion: if it's running, start it at 1.
outcomes.criticalFailure: As failure, and a face full of standing water. Nobody's hurt.

notes: Powering the line and clearing the feed run together; whoever does each is the party's call. The fight starts when both are done, or at once on a failed power check.
